# Governance Specification

<!-- Generated by scripts/openspec.js from specs/ (Spec Kit is the source of truth for these requirements). Edit specs/NNN-*/spec.md or openspec/capabilities.json, then run: node scripts/openspec.js sync -->

## Purpose

How the two partners keep the project honest: the human-written agent log, the project tracker and the public change log of rules.

## Requirements

### Requirement: REQ-020 Keep a human-written agent log in the repository
Each partner MUST keep a human-written agent log in the repository (`AGENT_LOG.md`) answering "What did the agent get wrong & how did you catch it?". The agent log is not a feature of the app.

Source: `specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md`, approved (shared spec). Code: `AGENT_LOG.md` (the partners write it; agents never do). The app has no agent log page: `/agent-log` redirects to the file; old in-app entries can be exported once from `/api/admin/agent-log.md`.

#### Scenario: REQ-020 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (e2e: "Agent log" section; preflight smoke "no in-app agent log")
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-030 Mirror the open spec checks
The project tracker SHOULD mirror the open spec checks, the requirements awaiting approval and the agents' queued work, through one sync that never duplicates an issue.

Source: `specs/002-research-layer/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: `scripts/project-sync.js`, `modules/project`, Specs view `/m/project#/specs`, `modules/project/specs.js`, `scripts/spec-index.js`.

#### Scenario: REQ-030 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (unit: project-sync, sync-source, project-specs and spec-status; `scripts/checkin.js` (`npm run checkin`), run daily by the scheduled agent task; research control room `/m/control` (research feed test: control room checks; e2e: "Research control room (REQ-030, REQ-018)" tests disclosure, navigation, saved actions, access, light/dark and phone width))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-051 Keep a public
In the extended version, the system SHOULD keep a public, append-only change log of scoring-rule and ontology versions (what changed, when) and of moderation actions (action, target, reason, without the admin's name), pruned to a year.

Source: `specs/004-parity/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: proposed, not built (today: admin-only `GET /api/admin/audit`).

#### Scenario: REQ-051 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (none yet (task T070))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require
